title: Disposition hint says Home but the summary and case management note say SNF (truth: SNF, pac rules apply); UTI with delirium in an 88-year-old

rationale.disposition: EDGE (deliberate mismatch): the registration hint says Home, a stale admission value that the case manager explicitly calls out; both the summary and the case management note state discharge to a skilled nursing facility, so the truth is SNF.
rationale.pac_list: EDGE: because the true disposition is SNF, the pac rules apply despite the Home hint; the Medicare-participating SNF list is documented.
rationale.pac_choice: Freedom to choose was explained and the family chose Willow Bend.
rationale.pac_quality_data: Care Compare star ratings and staffing measures were reviewed with the family.
rationale.followup: SNF attending within 72 hours, PCP within 1 week of returning home, and geriatrics in 6 weeks give who and when.
